{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "own": "<id from her_items or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description", ""her_items" — her own items; an item of the description that is one of them gets its id in "own""]}, "description": "Beige satin halter top with neck tie (her own item, from the photo): relaxed cut, hip length, milky beige, satin

High-waisted straight-leg trousers: full ankle length, dark chocolate brown #4A3328, wool-blend crepe

Textured single-breasted blazer: hip length, softly tailored, camel #B08A5E, wool tweed with a subtle weave (worn over the halter in the office, since autumn mornings are cool and the shoulders stay covered for work)

Penny loafers: low block heel, dark espresso brown #3A2A20, smooth leather

Structured top-handle bag: medium size, cognac #8B5A33, grain leather

Small hoop earrings: slim, polished gold #C9A24B, metal

Why this outfit works: Her beige satin halter stays the focal point, and the camel blazer gives it the structure and coverage an office needs. Chocolate trousers and espresso loafers ground the light top with deep, warm tones that echo her dark hair and eyes and suit the autumn season. The tweed's texture contrasts nicely with the smooth satin, so the look reads neat and polished rather than evening. Cognac and gold accents add warmth without competing with the tie detail at the neck.", "her_items": [{"id": "її-ф1", "name": "Beige satin halter top with neck tie"}]}
